workloads.hashmap_build_scan: Construct an empty map, insert n sequential keys with natural growth, then retrieve every value by key. Time is divided by n: one unit includes insertion and retrieval, allocation, and rehashing.
workloads.hashmap_hit: Query each existing sequential key; map preparation is outside timing. Unit: one query.
workloads.hashmap_miss: Query n through 2*n-1 in a map containing 0 through n-1. Unit: one absent-key query.
workloads.hashmap_wide_key: Query existing keys starting at 1000000. Unit: one query.
workloads.hashmap_collision: Query keys spaced by 2*n. These all began in bucket zero under the old direct-remainder CJR hash; the new multiplicative hash spreads this workload. Unit: one query.
